seoTitle: Running Pace Calculator (Pace, Time or Distance with Splits)
metaDescription: Fill in any two of distance, time and pace to get the third, with split times per kilometre or mile and the speed in km/h and mph.
intro: Solve for pace, time or distance and see your splits.
why:
Fill in any two of distance, time and pace and leave the third blank. The page calculates it and lists even-pace splits per kilometre or mile, with the speed in km/h and mph. Distance accepts a number or a name such as 5k, 10k, half or marathon.

Splits assume a steady pace. Hills, wind and fatigue are not modelled.
howTo: Type two of distance, time and pace.
Read the result and the split table.

faq.a: Use mm:ss or h:mm:ss, for example 25:30 or 1:45:00.

faq.q: Can I enter a half marathon?
faq.a: Yes. Type half, 10k, 5k or marathon in the distance box.

faq.q: Why does it ask for exactly two values?
faq.a: Three values would be able to disagree with each other. Two let the tool compute the third without a conflict.
No. The work happens in your browser and the page makes no network request with your input.
